label: TP
reason: Alert-1 (XSS) is TP because user-provided parameter 'param' flows into the LDAP filter string construction and is later printed to HTML without proper escaping in the final output. Alert-2 (LDAP Injection) is also TP because the same user input flows directly into the LDAP filter without sanitization. Both vulnerabilities are exploitable based on the code paths.

evidence.note: LDAP filter constructed using user input 'param' without sanitization
User input flows into HTML output through LDAP query results without sufficient encoding in some contexts
